title: Reid Scott Departs Law & Order After Three Seasons
text:
Reid Scott is leaving Law & Order after three seasons as Senior Detective Vincent Riley, with James Badge Dale set to join the show as its new lead.
Law & Order loses one of its major stars as Reid Scott departs the long-running NBC police procedural drama after three seasons as Senior Detective Vincent Riley.
The decision is reportedly voluntary, due to the demands of regularly traveling across the country and spending too much time away from his family in New York. Reid Scott has returned to the set to film several episodes that will wrap up the character's storyline before he leaves the series. The character will get a proper send-off that will conclude his arc in the series.
James Badge Dale will be joining Law & Order season 26 as its new lead, reportedly as a senior detective who will take over for Riley. However, it has not yet been revealed exactly when the transition between the two will take place, and Dale's character's identity is still shrouded in mystery. Cast changes are nothing new for shows that have been around as long as Law & Order. The series frequently adds new characters as older ones leave.
During his time on the show, Scott's Detective Riley teamed up with Junior Detective Theo Walker, played by David Ajala. Before Walker joined the precinct, Riley worked alongside Detective Jalen Shaw (Mehcad Brooks) until his departure in 2025. Scott himself joined Law & Order after Jeffrey Donovan, who played Detective Frank Cosgrove, left the show
